{{Quote|Sergeant Ath'en'terro, Chiss Expansionary Defense Force, permanently attached to Imperial Search and Recovery. It is an honor to work with our allies in the Empire.|Ath'en'terro|<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />}}
'''Ath'en'terro''', also known by his core name '''Thent''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the [[Dorn Base]] and provided [[Cipher Nine]] information on the whereabouts of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]].<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />
